utility.notes: BGE is the dominant investor-owned electric utility across central Maryland, including Anne Arundel County — not independently cross-checked against a dedicated BGE territory map this session, but well-established and not a genuinely ambiguous case like some other states researched this marathon.

value.name: Baltimore Gas and Electric (BGE)
value.notes: No Community Choice Aggregator was found serving Anne Arundel County's residential solar customers this session; BGE is recorded as both the distribution and default generation utility.

city.notes: This record represents Anne Arundel County's own Inspections and Permits process. Certain incorporated municipalities within the county (e.g., Annapolis) may operate their own separate building department and would be a separate AHJ not covered by this record — not independently verified this session.

permit_authority.value: Anne Arundel County Inspections and Permits
permit_authority.notes: Maryland is county-leaning for residential building permitting. Anne Arundel County's own Inspections and Permits department is the permitting authority.

interconnection_url.notes: See the identical statewide net-metering notes on the Montgomery County record (md-montgomery-montgomerycounty-pepco) — Maryland's net metering requirement is set at the state level (Public Utilities Article §7-306; COMAR 20.50.10) and applies to all Maryland investor-owned utilities including BGE.
